"""Algebraic frequency-conditioning witness on the actual trained V162 head."""
import os
from pathlib import Path

import torch
from profile_raw_kernel_inference import model_hash
from train_directional_bank_trial import read, ref, save

from demosaic.cfa import color_indices
from demosaic.late_harmonic_context import LateHarmonicContextDetail, dyadic_frequency_context
from demosaic.late_harmonic_phase import harmonic_phase_features
from demosaic.late_spectral_relative import relative_spectrum_features
from demosaic.prediction_archive import fingerprint
from demosaic.raw_frequency_features import frequency_descriptor

repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic')
torch.set_num_threads(2)
binding=read(repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V162-flat-target-anchor-v1/review-result-v1.json')['collections']['flat-anchor-EMA-step1000']
assert ref(binding['path'])==binding
collection=read(binding['path']);export=collection['export'];assert ref(export['path'])==export
rng=torch.get_rng_state().clone()
model=LateHarmonicContextDetail(256).double().eval()
saved=torch.load(export['path'],map_location='cpu',weights_only=True)
model.load_state_dict(saved['state_dict'],strict=True)
before=model_hash(model)
generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(16303)
spectra=[torch.fft.fft2(torch.randn(2,4,16,16,generator=generator,dtype=torch.float64),norm='ortho') for _ in range(2)]
sign=torch.ones(16,16,dtype=torch.float64);sign[2,6]=sign[-2,-6]=-1
changed=[value*sign for value in spectra]
noise=torch.ones(2,4,dtype=torch.float64);colors=color_indices('RGGB')[None].expand(2,-1)
def descriptors(a,b):
    first,second=frequency_descriptor(a,noise,colors),frequency_descriptor(b,noise,colors)
    relative=relative_spectrum_features(a,b,noise)
    return [torch.cat((first,second[:,:17]),1),relative,
        dyadic_frequency_context(torch.cat((first[:,:17],second[:,:17],relative),1))]
rows=[]
for name,a,b in zip(['same-bin48','relative8','dyadic210'],descriptors(*spectra),descriptors(*changed),strict=True):
    assert torch.equal(a,b)
    rows.append({'name':name,'exact_tensor_equal':True,'before':fingerprint(a.numpy()),'after':fingerprint(b.numpy())})
with torch.inference_mode():
    first=model.frequency_gain(*spectra,noise,colors)
    second=model.frequency_gain(*changed,noise,colors)
assert torch.equal(first,second)
phase_first=harmonic_phase_features(*spectra,noise);phase_second=harmonic_phase_features(*changed,noise)
difference=float((phase_first-phase_second).abs().max());assert difference>.01
assert model_hash(model)==before and torch.equal(rng,torch.get_rng_state())
target=repo/'docs/results/v163-phase-information-witness-v1.json';assert not target.exists()
save(target,{'status':'pass-conditioning-collision-and-new-information','V162_export':export,'export_collection':binding,
    'computation_dtype':'float64 / complex128;original float32 weights loaded exactly then promoted',
    'model_before_after':before,'old_conditioning':rows,'trained_frequency_gain_exact_tensor_equal':True,
    'old_gain_before':fingerprint(first.numpy()),'old_gain_after':fingerprint(second.numpy()),
    'new_phase_before':fingerprint(phase_first.numpy()),'new_phase_after':fingerprint(phase_second.numpy()),
    'new_phase_maximum_absolute_difference':difference,'CPU_RNG_unchanged':True,
    'separate_CPU_frequency_gain_calls':2,'root_model_forward_calls':0,'CUDA_calls':0,
    'new_parent_DINO_source_noise_RAW_calls':0,
    'scope':'Algebraic random-real-spectrum witness,not a retained photo or sensor simulation. A common sign flip at conjugate bins(2,6),(-2,-6) changes spatial phase while preserving real-image symmetry and all inherited frequency conditioning exactly. The actual trained V162 frequency gain remains exact,while16 new phase coordinates distinguish it. Existing spatial/support paths CAN see phase. This proves a representation distinction,not improved denoising,confidence,flat safety,or a whole-network invariance.',
    'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text())})
print('PASS actual V162 conditioning/gain exact;new phase input difference',difference)
